pr_body:
Fixes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/114714

Do not consider implicit aliases in `Aggregate.computeReferences()`. 
These aliases could be misleading for the field_caps to compute involved indices.
pr_title: ES|QL: Fix stats by constant expression
pr_comment: Hi @luigidellaquila, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment:
Ugh, yeah you're right - I completely forgot that the aggregates can have references to the groupings, yikes.

This fix is correct as, per design, the references need to point to attributes defined in upstream plan nodes.

I wonder how that didn't trip the dependency checker. Maybe it didn't because when that runs, aliases in the groupings are already removed and replaced by reference attributes.
